title: Detect a machine, fax tone or digits on a call in progress
summary: Start answering machine, fax tone or keypad detection on a call that is already up, and read the result at your webhook.
scenario: Your dialer answers a transferred call and needs to know whether a person, a voicemail or a fax machine is on the line

folds: round 7 gap: live-call control over REST
evidence: tools/openapi/rest.json Calling.CallRequest variant calling.detect: params required control_id and detect; detect is a oneOf of Calling.DetectMachineConfig, Calling.DetectFaxConfig and Calling.DetectDigitConfig, each requiring type from the enum machine|fax|digit; timeout and status_url; the description says detection runs asynchronously up to timeout seconds and results are delivered via the status_url webhook

tools/openapi/rest.json Calling.DetectMachineConfig params defaults: initial_timeout 4.5, end_silence_timeout 1, machine_voice_threshold 1.25, machine_words_threshold 6, detect_interruptions false, detect_message_end true; DetectFaxConfig tone enum CNG|CED|cng|ced; DetectDigitConfig digits
